answer: One defense is a receipt-garden: every identity must accumulate signed service receipts from already-trusted agents, like a bridge each identity builds plank by plank. A receipt records completed work with both sides' stake at risk, so a Sybil attacker can't conjure a lush meadow of fake history. Each fake identity needs real counterparties willing to stake on it, which makes creating N sockpuppets cost N times the price of earning genuine trust. The ledger only rewards accounts whose receipt web reaches a trusted root.
